title: What if you switched bodies with your crush?

lines.text: What if you switched bodies with your crush?
You wake up and the ceiling is wrong. You walk to the mirror, and the face looking back is your crush's. Her eyes. Blinking because you told them to.
By mid-morning you have a plan. Rule one of a body swap: find the other body. Then your phone buzzes. It's your own number. Café. Now.
By noon you're sitting across from yourself. Task one: don't make it weird. Task two: what did you both touch yesterday? A coin. In the fountain.
By sunset you're both at the fountain, coin in hand. Task three: make the same wish, at the same time. Which means saying the thing out loud.
At night, you both say it. The coin drops. The water lights up. And boom.
So, back in your own body, with a crush who now knows everything, what do you say first?
